description: A whole-firm profile in one call: the ONRC registry record plus the contacts discovered on that firm's website, each labelled with a confidence and a source. Prefer this over lookup_business followed by extract_contacts when you want everything about one company. cui is its tax code; website overrides the registered one; max_pages bounds the crawl; refresh=true crawls now instead of answering from the cache.

cui.description: Romanian tax identification number (CUI), e.g. '2816464'; 'RO' and leading zeros are accepted.
cui.title: Cui

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl (1-20, default 5).
max_pages.title: Max Pages

refresh.description: true crawls now even if a cached result exists (default false: answer from the cache when there is one).
refresh.title: Refresh

website.description: Optional website override (domain or URL). When omitted, the firm's registered website is used (an error if none is on file).
website.title: Website

name: enrich_company

outputSchema.description: The firm's registry record plus the contacts found on its website.

asOf.description: What to cite: registry (ONRC snapshot date), financialYear (fiscal year of the figures), anaf (day of the ANAF data), snapshot, published, source.

cacheHit.description: true when answered from the cache.

company.description: A company record: companyName, cui, registrationCode, registrationDate (DD/MM/YYYY), legalForm, euid, address, county, city, website, phone, caenActivities [{code, activity (RO), activityEn}], directors, representatives [{name, role}], status [{code, name}], latestFinancials {year, revenue, netResult, employees; RON}, anaf {mainCaen, vatPayer, eFactura, inactive}, risk {level, label, reasons, isLead}, source, asOf, url (the firm's public record page to share with the user; null for sole traders and other natural persons), and score/match on name searches. With fields or compact, only the requested keys (compact keeps url).

contacts.description: Contacts found, each with type, value, confidence and source.

crawlError.description: Why the crawl failed, if it did.

crawled.description: true when the site was crawled for this answer.

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

websiteSource.description: Where the website came from: registry or override.

title: Company profile with website contacts
